# Page template

**Foundation group:** page structure  
**Reviewed against:** GOV.UK Frontend 6.5.0 on 2026-09-09

Use the GOV.UK page template to supply the document structure, assets and shared components required for a consistent GOV.UK page.

## Rules

- Prefer the Nunjucks page template supplied by GOV.UK Frontend so template changes arrive with dependency updates.
- When translating the template to another framework, preserve the document language, UTF-8 declaration, viewport-fit setting, theme colour, body classes, asset links, skip link, header, main landmark, footer and JavaScript initialisation.
- Run the official body-start support snippet before rendering enhanced components; it adds js-enabled and govuk-frontend-supported only in capable browsers.
- Place the main page content in a uniquely identified main element targeted by the skip link.

## Accessibility contract

- Set the html lang attribute to the language of the page and use pageTitleLang or equivalent when the title differs.
- Keep the skip link as the first useful focusable control and make its target ID resolve to the main landmark.
- Set a unique, descriptive page title and retain browser zoom by using the official viewport declaration.
- Do not hide unenhanced component content while waiting for JavaScript.

## Restrictions and caveats

- The default GOV.UK header, footer, crown, favicon and other identity assets are only for eligible services; non-GOV.UK services must follow the official unbranded configuration guidance.
- Plain HTML copies do not receive upstream template fixes automatically and must be reviewed whenever GOV.UK Frontend changes.

## Token references

- `govuk.color.brand`
- `govuk.color.body-background`
- `govuk.color.template-background`
- `govuk.layout.page-width`

## Examples

### Essential document shell

```html
<!doctype html>
<html class="govuk-template" lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
    <title>Service page</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="/assets/govuk-frontend.min.css">
  </head>
  <body class="govuk-template__body">
    <script>document.body.className += ' js-enabled' + ('noModule' in HTMLScriptElement.prototype ? ' govuk-frontend-supported' : '');</script>
    <a class="govuk-skip-link" href="#main-content" data-module="govuk-skip-link">Skip to main content</a>
    <main class="govuk-main-wrapper" id="main-content"></main>
  </body>
</html>
```
